_: XMARKERS + LOAD-DOOR TELEPORTS. Two NEW interior cells (a hall + a back room) joined by a load-door PAIR so the player can walk between them, plus an XMarker travel anchor in the back room that a Travel NPC paths to. STRUCTURAL ONLY (not in-game verified): the door pair + XTEL + marker are written correctly per vanilla, but navmesh reachability inside a brand-new hand-unnavmeshed cell is UNCONFIRMED — a new cell has no navmesh, so the AI-traversed bits (Travel to the marker, the NPC walking through the door) may not path until a real navmesh is added in the CK. The door itself (player-activated) does not need navmesh and is the proven mechanic; positions are kept modest and near origin like the It.7 newcell example that rendered. Door base = FarmhouseLDoor01 (Skyrim.esm:0x029CB0, a load door); XMarkerHeading = Skyrim.esm:0x000034.
